card.name: Inside chemical compound names
card.fires_on: The comma inside numbered chemical names like 2,4-D and 1,3-butadiene, and the middle pieces of long drug names such as phenothiazine, bendroflumethiazide, nitazoxanide and dipyridamole.

modes.label: Comma in locants
modes.description: The comma between position numbers at the start of a chemical name.

modes.label: Middle of drug names
modes.description: A middle piece inside a long drug name, often before an -iazide or -anide ending.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next piece of a chemical or drug name, not toward ordinary words.
card.plain: It fires inside chemical and drug names, at the comma in numbered names or partway through long names like phenothiazine.
